description: Read one library page whole by the id `search` returned: main text, then its footnotes under their own label (the editor's words, never the author's), with book, author, printed volume/page, edition data and the shamela.ws link. Use shamela_read instead to read one body part at a time (unit "page"), a run of pages (unit "range") or a whole chapter (unit "section"), and shamela_cite (mode "printed_page") to turn a printed volume and page into ids. Not a search. Long pages are cut at 4 body parts of about 4,000 characters (2 without an API key): metadata.complete false, ending with the shamela_read call that continues it. A malformed id, or a page the library does not hold, returns a tool error.

id.description: Page id "{bookId}:{pageId}", e.g. "1681:10" — Shamela internal ids from a `search` result, not printed page numbers. Malformed or unknown ids return a tool error.

name: fetch

authorDied.description: Year of death in AH, or null.

complete.description: False when the page was longer than `fetch` reads in one call.

edition.description: Omitted when the library records none.

editor.description: Omitted when the library records none.

printedPage.description: Volume and page as the printing paginates it, or null.

publisher.description: Omitted when the library records none.

text.description: Main text, then the footnotes under their own label (the editor's words). When metadata.complete is false it ends with the shamela_read(unit='page') call that continues it.

title: Read a library page
